# Hatrick

> Hatrick is a social football prediction platform for creating private leagues, predicting real football match outcomes, tracking prediction accuracy, and competing with friends across major domestic and international football competitions.

Hatrick is available at https://hatrick.app/.

Hatrick is a football prediction game, not a sportsbook or gambling platform. Users compete based on the accuracy of their football predictions and earn points according to Hatrick's scoring rules.

Users can predict match outcomes, both teams to score (BTTS), and anytime goalscorers. Correct combinations can earn a Full Hatrick Bonus.

Hatrick supports private football prediction leagues for friends, families, workplaces, online communities, and other groups.

Core prediction types include:
- Match outcome: Home Win, Draw, or Away Win
- Both Teams to Score (BTTS): Yes or No
- Anytime Goalscorer
- Full Hatrick Bonus: Correctly predicting the required combination of outcome, BTTS, and goalscorer for a match

Hatrick includes football match tracking, prediction statistics, league standings, rankings, head-to-head information, and prediction accuracy metrics.

Supported football competitions include major domestic leagues and international competitions such as the UEFA Champions League, English Premier League, Spanish La Liga, Italian Serie A, German Bundesliga, French Ligue 1, FIFA World Cup, and other international tournaments.

Hatrick offers free access alongside an optional paid subscription with additional features. Current pricing, subscription features, availability, and terms should always be verified on Hatrick's official pricing page.
